instructions.title: Inspect Habitat Status
instructions.message: Begin with the Habitat status displays.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing life-support, general status, and emergency-status displays. This is an orientation review; do not infer readings that are not shown.
instructions.activity: Approach the existing Habitat monitor and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Review Water and Nutrition
instructions.message: Continue to the Habitat water and nutrition station.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing water and nutrition display to learn where this outpost information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the station and press E to inspect its existing display.

instructions.title: Use the Habitat Workstation
instructions.message: Locate the crew workstation in the Habitat.
instructions.guidance: Open or use the existing workstation interface and familiarise yourself with its role in the outpost.
instructions.activity: Approach the workstation and use its existing interaction.

instructions.title: Locate the Crew Rest Area
instructions.message: Identify the crew rest area in the Habitat.
instructions.guidance: Learn where the crew rests between Sols. Resting advances the mission day and remains subject to the required task checklist.
instructions.activity: Use the existing rest interaction to mark the orientation point; if tasks remain, return after completing them.

instructions.title: Inspect Engineering Monitoring
instructions.message: Proceed to the Engineering monitoring section.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing monitoring displays as one group and learn where engineering status information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the section interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Inspect Power Systems
instructions.message: Continue to the Engineering power section.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing power-system displays to familiarise yourself with the outpost's power information.
instructions.activity: Approach the section interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Inspect Engineering Life Support
instructions.message: Review the Engineering life-support section.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the existing life-support displays and learn where engineering environmental-system information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the section interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Inspect Diagnostics
instructions.message: Continue to the Engineering diagnostics workbench.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing diagnostics display and familiarise yourself with the workstation's purpose.
instructions.activity: Approach the workbench interaction point and press E to inspect the display.

instructions.title: Inspect Engineering Storage
instructions.message: Review the Engineering storage information display.
instructions.guidance: Locate the existing storage display and learn where storage information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the display interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Inspect Research Monitoring
instructions.message: Proceed to the Research Laboratory monitoring station.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing research-monitoring display and familiarise yourself with its role in the laboratory.
instructions.activity: Approach the station interaction point and press E to inspect the display.

instructions.title: Inspect Research Analysis
instructions.message: Continue to the Research Laboratory analysis station.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing research-analysis display to learn where scientific analysis information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the station interaction point and press E to inspect the display.

instructions.title: Review Seed Inventory
instructions.message: Locate the laboratory seed-storage inventory display.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the existing inventory display and familiarise yourself with where seed-storage information is shown.
instructions.activity: Approach the display interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Review Water and Nutrient Preparation
instructions.message: Continue to the laboratory water and nutrient preparation display.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing preparation display and learn where related laboratory information is presented.

destination.name: Research Laboratory Water and Nutrition Station

instructions.activity: Approach the display interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Inspect Water Quality
instructions.message: Review the laboratory water-quality display.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the existing water-quality display to learn where laboratory water information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the display interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Inspect Cultivation Environment
instructions.message: Proceed to the cultivation-environment display.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing display and familiarise yourself with where cultivation-environment information is shown.
instructions.activity: Approach the display interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Review Mission Objectives
instructions.message: Proceed to the Mission Control operations console.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing mission-objective and outpost-status display group to understand the current operational context.
instructions.activity: Approach the console interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Review Communications and Systems
instructions.message: Continue to the Mission Control communications and systems displays.
instructions.guidance: Review the existing display group and familiarise yourself with where communications and systems information is presented.
instructions.activity: Approach the console interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Review Terrain and Reconnaissance Systems
instructions.message: Review the Mission Control terrain and reconnaissance displays.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the existing terrain, observation-site, and drone-operation displays to familiarise yourself with the available planning interfaces.
instructions.activity: Approach the console interaction point and press E to inspect the display group.

instructions.title: Inspect Airlock Controls
instructions.message: Proceed to the Airlock control console.
instructions.guidance: Identify the existing control console and learn its general purpose. This orientation interaction does not initiate an airlock cycle or exterior launch.
instructions.activity: Approach the console interaction point and press E to inspect it.

instructions.title: Drone Section
instructions.message: Proceed to the Drone Section using the existing Airlock entrance.
instructions.guidance: Enter through the physical entrance, then locate and inspect the existing drone. Entering the section alone does not complete this task.
instructions.activity: Press E while near the drone to complete the physical inspection.

completion.title: Sol 1 Required Activities Complete
completion.message: All required Sol 1 demonstrations are complete. Return to the Habitat Rest Area and use the existing rest interaction to conclude Sol 1.
